findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_my_profile · Private data: calculate_print_resolution, calculate_print_bleed, get_print_file_setup, search_knowledge, search_content, talk_to_human, get_my_profile · Public sink: get_order_details, get_my_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_my_profile · Private data: calculate_print_resolution, calculate_print_bleed, get_print_file_setup, search_knowledge, search_content, talk_to_human, get_my_profile · Public sink: get_order_details, get_my_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
